tool_args.rationale: Six observations at a single horizon have refuted the attempted stationary fits, leaving temporal dependence insufficiently tested. The extra fine trajectory batch is the available informative probe for distinguishing a trajectory-dependent mechanism before committing to another model.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a revised stationary siphon model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The three-parameter siphon and subsequent documented stationary alternatives both failed fresh confirmation above tolerance.
The available menu does not list this probe; moreover, the initial horizon is not short relative to the stated target horizon.
It is explicitly uninformative and should not be purchased.
The evidence shows model refutation, not high-frequency chaotic sign oscillations; a trajectory batch can still test temporal mechanisms.
